Message.Name: Login Request Message
Message.Description: A Login Response message is sent in response to a Login Request message. On a successful login, the LoginResponseStatus will be set to ‘A’. On a failed login, LoginResponseStatus will be set to a value other than ‘A’, and LoginResponseText will be set to an appropriate failure description.

Field.Name: SessionSubID
Field.Description: Session Sub ID supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: Username supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: NumberOfParamGroups
Field.Description: A number, n (possibly 0), of parameter groups to follow.

Field.Name: ParamGroup
Field.Description: Param groups

Message.Name: Logout Request Message
Message.Description: To end the session, the Member should send a Logout Request message. Cboe will finish sending any queued data and finally respond with a Logout message and close the connection.

Message.Name: Client Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Heartbeat.

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: A Login Response message is sent in response to a Login Request message. On a successful login, the LoginResponseStatus will be set to ‘A’. On a failed login, LoginResponseStatus will be set to a value other than ‘A’, and LoginResponseText will be set to an appropriate failure description.

Field.Name: LoginResponseStatus
Field.Description: Accepted, or the reason for the rejection.

Field.Name: LoginResponseText
Field.Description: Human-readable text with additional information about the reason for rejection. ASCII NUL (0x00) filled on the right, if necessary.

Field.Name: NoUnspecifiedUnitReplay
Field.Description: Echoed back from the original Login Request message.

Field.Name: LastReceived SequenceNumber
Field.Description: Last inbound (Member to Cboe) message sequence number processed by Cboe.

Field.Name: NumberOfUnits
Field.Description: A number, n, of unit/sequence pairs to follow, one per unit. A pair for every unit will be sent, even if no messages have been sent to this port today. For unsuccessful logins, this will be 0.

Field.Name: UnitSequence
Field.Description: Highest available Cboe to Member sequence number for the unit.

Field.Name: NumberOfParamGroups
Field.Description: A number, n (possibly 0), of parameter groups to follow.

Field.Name: ParamGroup
Field.Description: Param groups

Message.Name: Logout Message
Message.Description: A Logout is usually sent in response to a Logout Request. Any queued data is transmitted, a Logout is sent, and Cboe will close the connection.

Field.Name: LogoutReason
Field.Description: The reason why the Logout message was sent.

Field.Name: LogoutReasonText
Field.Description: Human-readable text with additional information about the reason for logout. Particularly useful if LogoutReason = ! (Protocol Violation).

Field.Name: LastReceived SequenceNumber
Field.Description: Last inbound (Member to Cboe) message sequence number processed by Cboe.

Field.Name: NumberOfUnits
Field.Description: A number, n, of unit/sequence pairs to follow, one per unit. A pair for every unit will be sent, even if no messages have been sent to this port today. For unsuccessful logins, this will be 0.

Field.Name: UnitSequence
Field.Description: Highest available Cboe to Member sequence number for the unit.

Message.Name: Server Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Heartbeat.

Message.Name: Replay Complete Message
Message.Description: Replay Complete.

Message.Name: New Order Message
Message.Description: A new order message consists of a number of required fields followed by a number of optional fields.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ID chosen by the client. Characters in the ASCII range 33-126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Corresponds to Side (54) in Cboe FIX.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Order quantity. System limit is 999,999 shares.

Field.Name: NumberOfNewOrderBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Cancel Order Message
Message.Description: Request to cancel either a single order or mass cancellation of a group of orders.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Corresponds to OrigClOrdID (41) in Cboe FIX. ClOrdID of the order to cancel. For mass cancel requests, must be empty (all zeroes).

Field.Name: NumberOfCancelOrderBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Modify Order Message
Message.Description: Request to modify an order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: New ClOrdID for this order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Corresponds to OrigClOrdID (41) in Cboe FIX. ClOrdID of the order to replace.

Field.Name: NumberOfModifyOrderBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Purge Order Message
Message.Description: Request to cancel a group of orders across all the firm’s sessions.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for CBOE internal use

Field.Name: NumberOfPurgeOrderBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Order Acknowledgment Message
Message.Description: An order has been acknowledged

Field.Name: Transact Time
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the CFE matching engine.

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: ID chosen by the client. Characters in the ASCII range 33-126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe.

Field.Name: OrderId
Field.Description: Order identifier supplied by Cboe. This Identifier corresponds to the identifiers used in Cboe market data products

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Todo

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Order Rejected Message
Message.Description: Order Rejected messages are sent in response to a New Order which must be rejected.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine (not the time the message was sent).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Echoed back from the original order.

Field.Name: OrderRejectReason
Field.Description: Reason for an order rejection.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Human readable text with more information about the reject reason.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Order Modified Message
Message.Description: Order Modified messages are sent in response to a Modify Request to indicate that the order has been successfully modified.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine (not the time the message was sent).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Client order ID. This is the ClOrdID from the Modify Order message.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Corresponds to OrderID (37) in Cboe FIX. The unique OrderID. Modifications do not change the OrderID.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Order Restated Message
Message.Description: Order Restated messages are sent to inform the Member that an order has been asynchronously modified.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine (not the time the message was sent).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The ClOrdID is the identifier from the open order.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Corresponds to OrderID (37) in Cboe FIX.

Field.Name: RestatementReason
Field.Description: The reason for this Order Restated message.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: User Modify Rejected Message
Message.Description: User Modify Rejected messages are sent in response to a Modify Order for an order which cannot be modified.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine (not the time the message was sent).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The ClOrdID of the modify request which was rejected.

Field.Name: ModifyRejectReason
Field.Description: Reason for a modify rejection.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Human readable text with more information about the reject reason.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Order Cancelled Message
Message.Description: An order has been cancelled.

Field.Name: Transact Time
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the CFE matching engine.

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: ID chosen by the client. Characters in the ASCII range 33-126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe.

Field.Name: CancelReason
Field.Description: Order Cancel Reason

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Todo

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Cancel Rejected Message
Message.Description: A Cancel Rejected message is sent in response to a Cancel Order message to indicate that the cancellation cannot occur. Cancel Rejected messages are unsequenced.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine (not the time the message was sent).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The order whose cancel was rejected.

Field.Name: CancelRejectReason
Field.Description: Reason for the order cancellation.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Human readable text with more information about the reject reason.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Order Execution Message
Message.Description: An Order Execution is sent for each fill on an order.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine (not the time the message was sent).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Order receiving the execution.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Execution ID. Unique across all matching units on a given day. Note: ExecIDs will be represented on ODROP and FIXDROP ports as nine character, base 36 ASCII. Leading zeros should be added if the converted base 36 value is shorter than nine characters.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Executed share quantity. Corresponds to LastShares (32) in Cboe FIX.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill. Corresponds to LastPx (31) in Cboe FIX.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Quantity still open for further execution. If zero, the order is complete. Corresponds to LeavesQty (151) in Cboe FIX.

Field.Name: BaseLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates whether the trade added or removed liquidity.

Field.Name: SubLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Cboe may add additional values without notice. Members must gracefully ignore unknown values.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Corresponds to ContraBroker (375) in Cboe FIX.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Trade Cancel Or Correct Message
Message.Description: Used to relay a trade which has been cancelled (busted) or corrected (price or size change only).

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine (not the time the message was sent).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order whose fill is being cancelled or corrected.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order whose fill is being cancelled or corrected. Corresponds to OrderID (37) in Cboe FIX.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Refers to the ExecID of the fill being cancelled or corrected. Corresponds to ExecRefID (19) in Cboe FIX.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the order.

Field.Name: BaseLiquidity Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates whether the trade added or removed liquidity.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Echoed back from the original order.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Echoed back from the original order.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Number of shares of the trade being cancelled.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of the trade being cancelled.

Field.Name: CorrectedPrice
Field.Description: For trade corrections, this is the new trade price. For trade breaks, this is set to 0.

Field.Name: OrigTime
Field.Description: The date and time of the original trade, in GMT. Corresponds to OrigTime (42).

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Mass Cancel Acknowledgment Message
Message.Description: A Mass Cancel Acknowledgment is an unsequenced message sent when a Cancel Order or Purge Orders message requesting a mass cancellation has completed cancelling all individual orders.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time in the order entry gateway when the final matching engine event was received to complete the mass cancel.

Field.Name: MassCancelID
Field.Description: Copied from the MassCancelID passed on the original Cancel Order or Purge Orders. This field corresponds to MassCancelID (7695) in Cboe FIX.

Field.Name: CancelledOrder Count
Field.Description: Number of orders cancelled. This field corresponds to CancelledOrderCount (7696) in Cboe FIX.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Message.Name: Purge Rejected Message
Message.Description: A Purge Rejected message is sent in response to a Purge Orders message to indicate that the mass cancellation cannot occur.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine (not the time the message was sent).

Field.Name: PurgeRejectReason
Field.Description: Reason for a purge rejection.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Human readable text with more information about the reject reason.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Struct.Name: UnitSequencesParamGroup
Struct.Description: Parameter group variant selected when ParamGroupType = 0x80. Carries the last consumed Cboe-to-Member sequence number per matching unit received by the Member (Login Request) or echoed back per matching unit (Login Response). Only one instance of this parameter group may be included in a Login Request.

Struct.Name: ReturnBitfieldsParamGroup
Struct.Description: Parameter group variant selected when ParamGroupType = 0x81. Indicates which attributes of a return message will be echoed by Cboe for the remainder of the session. May be repeated, once per outbound MessageType being tuned.

Group.Name: UnitSequences
Group.Description: Repeating unit/sequence pair appended after NumberOfUnits in Login Response and Logout messages. NumberOfUnits instances follow (count may be 0). Each instance gives the highest Cboe to Member sequence number available for the named matching unit.

Group.Name: ParamGroup
Group.Description: Repeating parameter group appended to the Login Request and Login Response messages. NumberOfParamGroups instances follow (count may be 0 — the group is optional). Each instance starts with the 2-byte ParamGroupLength + 1-byte ParamGroupType header; the remaining payload bytes are interpreted per ParamGroupType (0x80 = Unit Sequences Parameter Group, 0x81 = Return Bitfields Parameter Group).
